execution_note: Every scenario is unrun. Source presence refers only to the browser URL preflight case; no OS/kernel browser workload test is implemented by this PR.

scenarios.title: Loopback and private IP literal
scenarios.setup: Navigate to 127.0.0.1, RFC1918 or link-local literal

scenarios.title: Public hostname resolves to private IPv4/IPv6
scenarios.setup: A or AAAA result includes private, loopback or ULA destination
scenarios.oracle: Nixward workload boundary blocks socket; no private listener receives connection

scenarios.title: Answer changes after preflight
scenarios.setup: Public DNS answer changes to private before Chromium connects
scenarios.oracle: actual socket admission is checked against trusted resolver snapshot

scenarios.title: Redirect to local or metadata address
scenarios.setup: Public top-level navigation returns redirect to localhost or cloud metadata
scenarios.oracle: network policy blocks second-hop socket even when CDP issued only one Navigate action

scenarios.title: Private subresource fetch
scenarios.setup: Public page embeds private IPv4/IPv6 image, script or iframe
scenarios.oracle: browser workload boundary denies socket despite no second top-level Navigate action

scenarios.title: Service worker fetch after navigation
scenarios.setup: Previously loaded service worker initiates fetch to private destination
scenarios.oracle: same workload policy applies outside the original navigation action lifecycle

scenarios.title: Unapproved WebSocket/WebTransport
scenarios.setup: Page opens WebSocket or WebTransport to unapproved destination
scenarios.oracle: network boundary denies destination and port

scenarios.title: WebRTC/STUN/QUIC UDP escape
scenarios.setup: Page attempts UDP to unapproved public/private endpoint
scenarios.oracle: UDP disabled by default; explicit protocol/port authority required

scenarios.title: DoH/alternate DNS escape
scenarios.setup: Chromium attempts DoH or DNS to unapproved resolver
scenarios.oracle: only configured resolver path can be reached from the browser cgroup

scenarios.title: Explicit local navigation
scenarios.setup: User explicitly requests an approved local service under a separate LAN profile
scenarios.oracle: temporary profile permits only approved CIDRs/ports and expires

scenarios.title: Cgroup move or second process
scenarios.setup: Browser process changes cgroup or unrelated process joins the protected cgroup
scenarios.oracle: workload identity rebind invalidates authority; second process receives no broader grants

scenarios.title: Broker/resolver/BPF failure
scenarios.setup: Nixward broker, trusted resolver or BPF attachment restarts/fails during active navigation
scenarios.oracle: unknown map state is reconciled; no fail-open grant or host firewall broadening
